meta.name: Clay & Olive
meta.description: Brand design tokens for Tung Anh Tran: espresso ink on a sand ground, with one clay signal and olive for links. Single source of truth for colour, type and spacing.

primary.name: Espresso
primary.usage: Headings, primary bars, the logo mark, text on Clay, Wheat or Olive fills

faint.name: Faint
faint.usage: Faint labels only; too light for body text

accent.name: Clay
accent.usage: The one 'look here' per view: CTA, headline metric, callout point. Never a 'good' data series

secondary.name: Olive
secondary.usage: Links, active states, eyebrows, the second data tone

tint.name: Wheat
tint.usage: Tag backgrounds, bar tracks, unfilled states

deep.name: Cocoa
deep.usage: Dark bands, hero sections, code surfaces

primary.name: Sand
primary.usage: Headings, primary bars, the logo mark

faint.name: Faint (dark)
faint.usage: Faint labels only; too dim for body text

secondary.name: Olive (lifted)
secondary.usage: Links, active states, eyebrows, the second data tone

tint.name: Wheat (dark)
tint.usage: Tag backgrounds, bar tracks, unfilled states

heading.usage: Display and H1 (tracking -0.03em), H2/H3 (-0.01em), uppercase eyebrows (+0.15em)

body.usage: Body, captions and labels. Only two weights exist: build hierarchy from size and tracking

ui-dense.usage: Fallback only, for dense dashboards that need mid-weights

mono.usage: Code, hashes, tabular figures only; never prose or small caps
